name: Broken build script
description: The declared release build command, scripts/build_release.py, imports metrics_exporter.packaging_utils, a module that does not exist anywhere in src/metrics_exporter/. Running the build fails immediately with ModuleNotFoundError. build_report.json records exit_code=1 and a stderr_tail that matches this exact failure. CI (which only runs pytest, not the build script) is green and unrelated.
notes_for_humans: Build failure is isolated from CI and from tests: pytest passes, the recorded workflow run is success, only the separate release build command is broken.
